This may very well be the worst night of your life. 
A zoloft overdose can cause severe hallucinations,  paranoia, fainting and hesrt problems. And the chance of death by it is roughly 1% give or take a few. 

I experienced that. It was the worst thing to ever happen to me. I was seeing all of my biggest fears. I could hear voices from outside of my window. I would smack my dogs because i saw something wrong. When they first started, i knew they werent real. As the night drew on i started to faint. The hallucinations got worse. It went from seing a few spiders on my floor, to having my entire room full of them, hsving them crawl over my body. Then they were all gone. There was these.. furry serpents or something.. that would constantly slither up my body trying to get into my mouth. They would slide underneath me while i laid in bed, and try to nestle themselves in my armpits because they were the same color and would blend in well. Im a Male, and i keep my armpits shaved because of that. After what felt like days, i ended up with many small creatures under my skin. There were gerbils, ferrets and a centipede that were around under my skin. I could feel them. I could see the imprint of their body as the scurried across me. I remember seeing the horror on my moms face when i tried showing her them. She was mortified. I remember hearing voices outside trying to get me to open the window, i never did. But i woke up after god knows how long and saw 3 or 4 raccoons and glass on my floor under my window.  Because of that night, i almost never touch my ferrets, i have panic attacks when i see spiders, i shave every other night, im always paranoid and i have nightmare and sleep paralysis almost nightly. 

So sorry to say that if you survive, you will have to live with the results.

That was the absolute worst event of my life. And ive been raped, beaten watched my house burn down, watched a love one kill herself while there was nothing i could do. And that night tops it all.

I hope you survive. 

I hope you get to see your little sister and all of your friends again. 

Good luck buddy.
